history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: the CSV name 'Hanuman Mandir' is generic and several Hanuman shrines exist in and around Barnala, so no single referent can be confirmed. Documented here provisionally is the 'Hanuman Mandir' at NH-71, Shakti Nagar, Barnala - the geocoder's top full-address match for a Hanuman Mandir in Barnala (30.37209, 75.52503). Other candidates: a meta.ai/place listing for 'Hanuman Mandir, Barnala Sub-District' at 30.394113, 75.566349; a Justdial-listed 'Hanumaan Temple' at Attar Singh Wala, Barnala. Note: the 'Shri Hanuman Mandir Barnewala Dhanaula' found online is in Dhanaula, a separate town, and is NOT a Barnala-town referent - excluded. No published history, founding date, or dedicated temple website could be found; nothing was invented. The image is query-matched from an image search and its exact subject is unconfirmed. Re-verify against the CSV compiler's intended referent.

name: Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Barnala is the headquarters of Barnala district, Punjab (a separate district since 2006, carved out of Sangrur). It sits at about 227 m elevation on the plains of Malwa, connected by rail and road to Bathinda, Ludhiana, Sangrur and Mansa.

travel.airport: Chandigarh International Airport, about 150 km away (verify).
travel.road: The Shakti Nagar shrine is listed on NH-71 in Barnala; reachable by road within Barnala town.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Tuesdays and Hanuman Jayanti for festive visits.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published - verify locally before visiting.
